lines: Pursuant to Code of Alabama Section 17-13-18, I hereby publicly proclaim the 2026
Democratic Primary Runoff results. Subject to the provisions therein, I declare the candidate
names attached as nominees to appear on the November 3, 2026 Alabama General Election
ballot. The names below are declared winners of their respective June 16, 2026 Primary
State Senate District 2 — Rudolph Valentino Drake
State House District 82 — Pebblin W. Warren
This certificate is subject to such disqualifications or corrective action as hereafter may be
Given under my hand, this first day of July, 2026.
Paid for by the Alabama Democratic Party
